desc: Hornady Security® Lock Boxes provide secure storage for handguns and other valuables at home, on a nightstand, in the car, or when traveling. All Hornady Security® Lock Boxes come with a heavy duty 1500 lb. rated steel cable that secures to any stationary object including a vehicle seat or heavy piece of furniture. The patented, space-saving receiver of the cable allows maximum storage space inside the box. Lock Boxes also provide security for concealed carry permit holders.
